name: calendar
title: Calendar
description: Month grid on DayPicker v10 for a single day or a range: one fluid hover highlight across one or two months that follows keyboard focus, a range band that previews the end under the pointer, booked (struck through) and unavailable days, ISO week numbers, a cellSize prop and fill mode, and a direction-aware month slide.
docs: Docs & live playground: https://www.fluidfunctionalism.com/docs/calendar. Craft notes, the color, layout and motion decisions to keep when you change it: https://github.com/mickadesign/fluid-functionalism/blob/main/skills/fluid-functionalism/references/craft.md#calendar.
